name: High-gain lead wah
desc: Cry Baby before a high-gain amp, slightly lower Q and a level push: screaming, cutting metal leads

refs.why: Hammett's Cry Baby lead break cutting over the riff
signature Cry Baby wah in his Black Label Society rig

notes: The crate's high-gain start: Q 80 tames fizz into the amp, +3 dB hits the preamp harder; auto-engage so the foot only rocks
